title: Employment Contract Analysis
summary: This is a Employment Contract. Employee: Avery Example. The employer named in this contract is Example Research. The monthly salary is RM6,000, as stated in the compensation clause. Employment begins on 2027-01-01, which is the agreed start date. During probation, either party may terminate with fourteen days written notice.
plainLanguageExplanation:
After written confirmation, either party may terminate with sixty days written notice.

The notice terms depend on employment stage. Start date: 2027-01-01 The employee serves a six-month probation period from the start date. During probation, either party may terminate with fourteen days written notice. After written confirmation, either party may terminate with sixty days written notice. Review the probation and confirmation terms together before applying either notice provision.

The employee must protect confidential information as part of their obligations under the contract.
